title: Preserve native dataframe types through indexable and cross-validation
answers: Why does cross-validation pass a Narwhals dataframe to my estimator?
Must indexable preserve the input dataframe type?
Where should dataframe type preservation be tested?
body:
Symptom: Cross-validation passes Narwhals-wrapped dataframes or targets to estimators expecting the original native container types.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/validation.py:_make_indexable converted dataframe inputs with nw.from_native instead of returning them unchanged.
Fix pattern: Preserve native dataframe containers when making inputs indexable so downstream estimators receive their original types.
Constraints: Type preservation is not universal: sklearn/utils/tests/test_validation.py:test_indexable_return_type explicitly expects sparse_csc_array inputs to become csr_array.
Regression coverage: sklearn/utils/tests/test_validation.py:test_indexable_return_type checks container types; sklearn/model_selection/tests/test_validation.py:test_cross_val_and_permutation_test_on_dataframe requires estimators to receive native dataframe and target types without unwrapping.
applies: Changes to indexable container handling or dataframe and target propagation through cross-validation.
